_comment: Source of truth for what each page SHOULD show. When you change a price, update it HERE FIRST, then update the page, then run: npm run check-prices. Amounts are in cents so they compare cleanly against Stripe's unit_amount.

closing.html.label: Closing Navigator
closing.html._checkoutPage: Closing is the only product whose checkout is not on its own page. closing.html sells a FREE scorecard; the customer meets a Stripe button one step later, on /closing-scorecard. Without this the checker looked for a button on closing.html, found none, and failed the whole deploy gate -- so the price on the page and the amount Stripe charges were going unchecked on the one product where they are furthest apart.
closing.html._tiers: Flat $59. The retired $29 document-only tier is deliberately no longer listed as an allowed price: charging less for a thinner upload gave customers a reason to withhold the Loan Estimate and purchase contract, which are the documents that find recoverable money. Extra documents now add checks at no extra cost. If $29 shows up on the page again, this check should fail.

_skipped.streaming.html: Two-tier page: a free analyzer ($0, no checkout) and one paid subscription at $19.99/year. The paid button is a REPLACE_WITH_ANNUAL_PAYMENT_LINK placeholder until the Stripe Price and Payment Link are created, so there is no link to compare a price against yet. Re-enable this check by moving streaming.html into `pages` once the link exists.
_skipped.subscriptions.html: REPRICED, LINK NOT YET CREATED. The price moved from $49 to $29 on 2026-09-19 (docs/SUBSCRIPTIONS-AUDIT.md section H: $49 sat above /home-savings, which covers subscriptions AND utilities and insurance for the same money, and above /streaming, which does the streaming half better for $19.99/yr). subscriptions.html now shows $29 and its button href is the literal REPLACE_WITH_29_ONE_TIME_LINK, which the page's own script refuses to navigate to -- so nobody can be shown $29 and charged $49, which is exactly the buying.html defect this checker was written for. Re-enable by creating the $29 one-time Payment Link in Stripe, putting its URL in the page AND in stripeLinkId here, deactivating the old $49 link 4gMaEXbsw2E49co5RKabK07, and moving this entry back into `pages` with expectedPriceCents 2900. tests/subscriptions-page.test.js fails if the placeholder ever becomes clickable.

unreferencedActiveLinks._comment: Payment links that are ACTIVE in Stripe on purpose while no product page in this config points at them. check-prices.js fails on any active link not listed here, because an unexplained sellable link is exactly what this catches: a retired $29 Closing tier stayed active for six days after the product moved to $59, linked from nowhere, and anyone holding the URL could have bought a $59 report for $29. Each entry needs a reason. If you cannot write one, deactivate the link instead.
unreferencedActiveLinks.plink_1U6Ie6H9DnCfGBIZwuRsRcpy: RETIRED — StreamNavigator Pro, $4.99/mo. The streaming product moved to a single $19.99/year tier on 2026-09-12 and no page links here any more. This link is still ACTIVE in Stripe and must be DEACTIVATED: anyone holding the URL can still subscribe at a price we no longer sell, and monthly billing is the structure the pricing change was meant to end. Existing subscribers keep their subscription either way — deactivating a Payment Link stops new sign-ups, it does not cancel anyone.
unreferencedActiveLinks.plink_1U6Ie6H9DnCfGBIZpyylQEqI: RETIRED — StreamNavigator Family, $8.99/mo. Same as above: the Family tier no longer exists (household is included in the $19.99/year tier), nothing links here, and the link must be DEACTIVATED in Stripe.
unreferencedActiveLinks.plink_1U9r26H9DnCfGBIZb7nwd3OH: RETIRED -- Subscription Navigator Report, $49 one-time. The product moved to $29 on 2026-09-19 and subscriptions.html no longer links here. This link is still ACTIVE in Stripe and must be DEACTIVATED: anyone holding the URL can still be charged $49 for a product the page prices at $29. Its checkout URL is https://buy.stripe.com/4gMaEXbsw2E49co5RKabK07.
